admin.acqAutoApproveHint: Otherwise only accounts with the requests.auto capability skip the approval queue.
admin.acqDeleteAfterImportHint: Remove the torrent and its data once imported into the library (frees the download folder and stops seeding; the library copy is kept).
admin.acqEnabledHint: Without this, only manual downloads (interactive search) work.
admin.acqEngineDesc: The BitTorrent engine built into KROMA (librqbit). Restarted automatically when these settings change.
admin.acqForbiddenKeywordsHint: Any release containing one of these words is rejected.
admin.acqGeneralDesc: Automatically search your indexers for approved requests.
admin.acqPreferHevcHint: Large score bonus for x265/HEVC releases.
admin.acqQualityDesc: How the decision engine scores releases. HEVC-first: that is KROMA's philosophy.
admin.acqReplaceOnUpgradeHint: When a search grabs a better release for something already in the library, delete the file it replaces once the new one has landed. Off keeps both.
admin.acqRequiredKeywordsHint: Comma-separated; a release must contain all of them (e.g. VOSTFR).
admin.acqVpnDesc: Kill switch, tunnel check and whether indexer searches route through the VPN.
admin.aiApiKeyHint: Required for Anthropic / OpenAI; not needed for a local Ollama
admin.aiBaseUrlHint: e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama). Leave empty for Anthropic.
admin.aiBaseUrlOpenrouter: Optional defaults to openrouter.ai; models like "qwen/qwen-2.5-7b-instruct"
admin.aiEnabledHint: Generates personalized home sections via the "Personalized sections" job
admin.aiNoProviders: No providers yet add one to enable AI features.
admin.aiProviderHint: openai = any OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, llama.cpp…); anthropic = Claude
admin.aiProvidersHint: Register one or more model providers and pick the default used for generation.
admin.aiSectionDesc: Language model for personalized sections and taste profiles.
admin.aiSub: Configure the language model that names your personalized sections and builds taste profiles.
admin.autoScanHint: Rescans the folders regularly for new items.
admin.backupEncryptHint: Strongly recommended without it the file holds credentials in clear. You'll need the password to restore.
admin.backupEncryptedFile: This backup is encrypted enter its password to restore it.
admin.backupExportDesc: Downloads a ZIP with accounts, settings, watch history, resume positions, invites and custom avatars. The catalogue itself is rebuilt by a scan on the target.
admin.backupExportFailed: Export failed check the server logs and try again.
admin.backupImportDesc: Restores accounts, settings and history from a backup file, then re-scans your libraries. Existing entries are overwritten by the backup.
admin.backupImportFailed: Import failed is this a valid KROMA backup file?
admin.backupImported: Backup imported ({users} accounts) a re-scan has started. If your media paths differ, update the library folders, then re-scan.
admin.backupPasswordHint: Optional. Leave empty for an unencrypted ZIP; set one to encrypt the backup (you'll need it to restore).
admin.backupPasswordRequired: This backup is encrypted enter its password.
admin.backupResetHint: Wipe this server's accounts, settings and history before importing (a clean clone of the source).
admin.backupSub: Move your server to another machine: export your data, then import it there.
admin.backupWarning: An unencrypted backup contains credentials (password hashes, API keys). Set a password to encrypt it, or store it somewhere safe and never share it.
admin.cacheLimitDesc: Maximum space reserved for downloaded posters and backdrops
admin.cantDeleteSelf: You can't delete your own account
admin.clearCacheDesc: Frees {size} of transcodes and downloaded images
admin.confirmClearPin: Clear {name}'s PIN? Their remembered devices will ask for the account password on the next switch-in.
admin.confirmRevokeInvite: This invitation link will stop working immediately.
admin.cpuAveragesWithMedia: Averages: KROMA Server {kroma} % · of which transcoding {media} % · System {sys} %
admin.downloadsSub: Live download queue, history and torrent clients.
admin.emailDesc: How credential-reset links reach your users. The one-time code never travels by email: read it to the user yourself.
admin.historyScreenSub: Every session this server has played.
admin.httpsEnabledHint: Serve HTTPS with an auto-generated certificate, for a secure origin on the local network (needed by the Web Crypto API). The HTTP port keeps working. Restart the server to apply.
admin.httpsRedirectHint: Automatically redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS (no effect while HTTPS is off). The certificate download stays reachable over HTTP. Avoid if some clients can't handle the self-signed certificate. Restart the server to apply.
admin.hwAccelDesc: KROMA streams in direct play; only audio is re-encoded when needed
admin.indexersSub: Torznab endpoints (Jackett, Prowlarr) used to search for requested titles.
admin.introDetectionHint: off · chapters (free, from embedded chapters) · fingerprint (audio analysis, heavy: run the 'Marker detection' job)
admin.inviteExpiryHint: The link stops working after this period.
admin.inviteIntro: Generate an invitation link to share. The person creates their account with the checked permissions.
admin.inviteShareHint: Send this link to the person you're inviting. It can only be used once.
admin.invitesEmptyHint: Links you create appear here until they're used or expire.
admin.jobsSub: Automate maintenance, recommendations and indexing on a cron schedule or run by hand.
admin.librariesSub: Your media collections and their scans.
admin.localDiscoveryHint: Automatic detection on the local network
admin.logsSub: Recent log lines from the server and its modules, live.
admin.mediaConcurrencyHint: How many heavy background passes (storyboards, subtitles, intro/credits) run at once. 0 = auto (leaves a core free). Lower it if processing makes the server sluggish.
admin.modulesCatalogError: No module catalog could be fetched
admin.modulesCatalogErrorHint: The default registry is modules.kroma.tv, which serves the modules.json attached to this project's GitHub Releases. Point the official slot elsewhere, or add another registry, from the Registries panel.
admin.modulesInstalledEmptyHint: Install one from the Discover tab.
admin.modulesLocalBuildHint: The binary on disk is newer than the installed artifact: a local build replaced it.
admin.modulesLogsEmpty: This module has not logged anything yet.
admin.modulesLogsHint: Recent output from this module's process.
admin.modulesPointsEmpty: No extension point is declared by the installed modules.
admin.modulesPointsHint: Every point the installed modules define, who answers it, and who calls it. A point in green is answered by a module that is enabled and running.
admin.modulesReinstallHint: Fetch the module again from where it was installed from, then restart it.
admin.modulesRestartHint: Stops the sidecar and starts it again from the binary on disk.
admin.modulesSub: Install, update and configure this server's modules.
admin.modulesUninstallMsg: {name}'s files and process are removed from the server. Its settings are kept.
admin.modulesUnmetHint: Installed and running, but nothing answers what it needs: {needs}.
admin.modulesUpToDateHint: Installed modules are at their newest registry version.
admin.name: Name
admin.namingSub: File naming templates (Sonarr/Radarr format) and library rename.
admin.noAdminAccess: You don't have access to server administration.
admin.noLibraries: No libraries. Add one to start a scan.
admin.noUsersPermission: You don't have permission to manage users.
admin.notifImageEmptyHint: Upload an image and it will appear here.
admin.notifSendHint: Sent for real: the bell, the stored row, and push. People who muted that category are not counted.
admin.notifTestEveryoneWarning: This writes a notification into every account on this server. It cannot be unsent.
admin.notifTestMuted: Nobody received it: that category is muted.
admin.notificationsSub: Write a notification and choose who receives it.
admin.pageAcquisitionSub: Quality profile and the embedded torrent engine for automatic downloads.
admin.pageNetworkSub: Remote access, secure connections and discovery.
admin.pipelineSub: Per-item processing broken into stages. Incremental and resumable: a re-run only does what is missing, and failed items are individually visible and retriable.
admin.publicUserList: Show the profile list on the login screen
admin.publicUserListHint: When off, nobody can list existing accounts from the server URL; sign in with email and password
admin.qualityPerfDesc: KROMA streams by direct play (remux): only the number of concurrent sessions is capped there's no server-side video re-encoding.
admin.rangeIncomplete: The server has not been running long enough to cover this window.
admin.registriesHttps: A registry URL must start with https://
admin.registriesOfficialDesc: The first-party catalog at modules.kroma.tv (served live from this project's GitHub Releases). It cannot be removed, and a module it publishes always wins over one with the same id from another registry. Leave the field empty for the built-in URL.
admin.registriesPreviewFail: This URL can't be read as a catalog
admin.registriesShadowed: {count} hidden (already provided by a higher-priority registry)
admin.registriesSub: The catalogs the Store reads. Adding one lists its modules; every install stays checksum-verified.
admin.registriesTrustNote: A module is native code this server executes: only add registries you trust.
admin.remoteBinaryMissing: cloudflared binary not available on the server.
admin.remoteManagedHint: Optional. If your server has no tunnel yet, KROMA can run and supervise cloudflared to expose a public HTTPS URL without port-forwarding. If you already run a tunnel (a shared container, a system service), leave this off and just set the public URL.
admin.remoteTokenHint: Paste the Cloudflare Tunnel connector token. The server runs cloudflared and supervises it.
admin.resetAccessHint: Mints a single-use link and a code. The link alone is not enough: read the code to the user over a channel you trust.
admin.resetCodeHint: Read this code to the user yourself. It never travels with the link, so the link alone resets nothing.
admin.resetManual: No delivery configured: copy the link yourself. It carries the code, so the user only picks a new password.
admin.resetMetadataConfirm: Clear all TMDB metadata? Posters and descriptions will disappear until the next enrichment.
admin.resetMetadataDesc: Clears every TMDB entry (posters, cast, embeddings) to force a fresh enrichment. Then run the “TMDB enrichment” task.
admin.resetRequestedHint: This user asked for a reset from the sign-in screen.
admin.resetUserConfirm: Mint a reset link for {name}? Any unused reset stops working, and completing it signs out every device.
admin.secretReplace: Paste a new value to replace it
admin.serverIdentityDesc: How your server appears on your devices
admin.showRecentHome: Show recent additions on the home screen
admin.smtpEnabledHint: The server hands reset and verification emails to this SMTP server.
admin.smtpFromHint: The sender your users see, e.g. kroma@yourdomain.tld.
admin.smtpPasswordHint: Stored on this server only, never shown again.
admin.smtpTestHint: Sends a test email to your own address with the saved settings.
admin.tcSoftwareWarning: No usable encoder found: every frame is rebuilt by the CPU.
admin.tcTooSlow: The encoder is producing less than a second of film per second. Playback will stall.
admin.themeSongsHint: Loop a series' title theme on its detail page (downloaded on the next scan)
admin.tmdbLanguageHint: Used to match a title to TMDB, and for anything with no reader in front of it: enrichment, jobs, modules. A signed-in reader gets their own language where one is stored. Auto = the server default.
admin.topUsersEmpty: No account has watched anything in this window.
admin.transcodeCacheLimitDesc: Disk budget for live HLS segments. Idle streams are trimmed oldest-first; a stream playing now is never interrupted
admin.usersEmptyHint: Invite members to share your libraries.
admin.usersSub: Manage access and the sharing of your libraries.
admin.verificationManual: No delivery configured: copy the link and deliver it yourself.
admin.vpnKillSwitchHint: Pauses downloads when the proxy is unreachable or not diverting traffic.
admin.vpnRouteIndexers: Route indexer searches through the VPN
admin.vpnRouteIndexersHint: Send built-in indexer traffic through the tunnel too (not only torrents). If the VPN is down, searches fail instead of leaking.
admin.vpnSub: One tunnel for the whole stack: torrent downloads and, optionally, indexer searches. WireGuard in, kill switch on.
admin.watchAutoScanHint: Detects file additions/removals and re-scans automatically.
